featured.name: Elena & Marco Pellegrini
featured.title: The coast, rearranged twice — and better for it
featured.quote: We had already booked a hotel in Positano when our planner asked what we actually wanted from the week. The honest answer was quiet evenings, not beach clubs. She moved our base two villages along, put the busy days at the start, and left the last three days almost empty. Best of all, she kept the original booking refundable while we decided. Nothing felt like a sales conversation.
featured.imageAlt: A terraced coastal village on the Amalfi Coast at dusk

reviews.title: The terrace we almost skipped
reviews.quote: Nobody had asked us what we wanted to be doing at six in the evening. Everything after that question was built around the answer.
reviews.name: Rui Almeida

reviews.title: Milan to Rome without a single airport
reviews.quote: Three trains, two hotel changes, zero stress. Our planner sent platform numbers and a note on which side of the carriage to sit.
reviews.name: James Whitfield

reviews.title: A hike I didn't think I could do
reviews.quote: They cut the second day in half without making me feel like a problem. I still finished the route, and I still got the view.
reviews.name: Daniel Okafor

reviews.title: The train window was the holiday
reviews.quote: Bernina in second class, lunch from a bakery, and a hotel that met us at the station. Simple things, arranged properly.
reviews.name: Clara Hoffmann

reviews.title: Santorini with three children and no meltdowns
reviews.quote: Ferries timed around naps, an apartment with a kitchen, and a guide who genuinely liked our kids. That is not luck, that is planning.
reviews.name: Priya Raman

reviews.title: Our honeymoon was planned in two calls
reviews.quote: We were exhausted from wedding admin. One call to hear what we wanted, one to confirm, and then it simply happened.
reviews.name: Anna & Tomáš Novák

reviews.title: Lisbon in the rain, still perfect
reviews.quote: Our walking day was washed out and a message came through before breakfast with a replacement: tiled interiors, a bookshop, a long lunch. We never once opened a map ourselves.
reviews.name: Sophie Laurent

reviews.title: A last-minute change saved the week
reviews.quote: A rail strike was announced the day we flew. They rebooked the whole middle of the trip by the time we landed in Málaga, and we paid nothing extra.
reviews.name: Nadia El-Sayed

reviews.title: Vienna with my mother, aged 78
reviews.quote: Every transfer was short, every hotel had a lift, and there were proper chairs at every stop. She has already asked when we are going again.
reviews.name: Marta Kowalska
